metadata.title: MAT-SPEC-010: Final Evidence Freeze and Reproducible Archive of the MAT-SPEC-001–010 Materials Sonification Research Programme
metadata.description: A deterministic external archive of the closed MAT-SPEC-001–010 research programme. It contains actual generated artifact bytes, attributed source excerpts, source-rights and literature records, methodology, tests, claim and source inventories, and SHA-256 provenance. It reproduces declared computational transformations but does not establish independent helium phase classification, independent experimental replication, human auditory validation, E8 physics, or a new physical law.
